frozen_manifest.state: Fresh Gunicorn/DB fixture; six cold probes then same-server sustained arrivals. OS/PG shared caches not reset or asserted cold
frozen_manifest.error_policy: Every non200 dynamic response, transport error or timeout is failed; uploads require302; final drain expiry classified failed/timeout
frozen_manifest.instrumentation: Monotonic per-request timestamps/async ledger; client-process GC callbacks during arrivals/drain with monotonic intervals and collector-thread CPU; event overlap reviewed after drain, causal callback overhead not_measured; GC policy unchanged; Gunicorn access logs; no app CPU/DB/RSS sampling
frozen_manifest.client: asyncio local HTTP, no pending-request cap, total HTTP transaction deadline65s; no redirect following
frozen_manifest.client_fixture_preparation: One gc.collect(2) after fixture/auth/upload construction, before arrival clock; enabled/thresholds unchanged, automatic GC remains active during load. Previous observed client GC321.913ms overlaps273.107ms of273.462ms maximum emission delay; no backend improvement attributed to this preparation

worker_observer.scope: Synthetic IDs already emitted by client; WSGI entry/end, inclusive context/validation/render and SQL execute wall/thread CPU; validation snapshots each1000calls, partial events retained; no real URI/SQL/parameters; not TCP accept or exact queue time; causal overhead not_measured
worker_observer.clock: time.monotonic in local worker processes; client loop.time origin explicitly recorded; same-host clock comparability checked after terminal
worker_observer.phase_overlap: SQL may be inside context/validation/render; native lazy evaluation/GC included in caller intervals; no additive phase partition

client_gc_preparation.scope: One full collection in test-client preparation after fixture/auth/upload construction, before asyncio arrival clock. No gc.disable or threshold mutation; collector stays active during load. Objects aren't ORM models or SQL rows; source provenance of individual collected objects not_measured. Backend/Gunicorn processes unaffected.

client_gc.scope: gc.callbacks start/stop intervals of this process; CPU is collector thread only. Includes callback overhead and wall scheduling, not allocations or SQL/ORM rows. Events overlap enclosing rule/request intervals; never add or subtract them as an independent phase. Policy unchanged, no gc.collect/disable/threshold mutation. Causal callback overhead not_measured; no attribution to other processes or earlier runs.

client_gc_emission_overlap.scope: Union of client GC intervals intersected with scheduled-to-emitted delays, same monotonic origin. Overlap measured, not sole causal attribution; CPU/scheduling/network/other processes remain separate. GC events before the arrival clock or during drain do not imply arrival delay. No thresholds or collector policy changed.

summary.percentile_population: All emitted terminated requests, including errors/timeouts; no successful-only filter

summary.emitter: Async tasks, no pending-request cap; whole-request timeout bounds lifetime
summary.gunicorn_dynamic_service_limits: Completed Gunicorn log rows only; interrupted/unlogged/timeouts excluded here, included in observable latency/failed population. Health/cold/uploads excluded.
